title: hive-memory render: request body
description: Renders, or re-renders, the knowledge projection for the envelope's scope and an audience from the effective rules and each fact's canonical owner, recording the sources at the revisions read, the renderer version and the digest. One projection exists per scope and audience; a re-render is a new rendering of the same record. See spec/pool.md, Generated knowledge.

at.description: The instant the rules are resolved for. Absent means the command's clock.
